title: Borrow<str> on Keyword enables HashMap lookup with bare &str
description: Keyword implements Borrow<str>, AsRef<str>, and Deref<Target=str>. This allows HashMap<Keyword,bool>::contains_key(keyword::SEEN) without any conversion. Without Borrow<str>, every lookup would require Keyword::from(keyword::SEEN) allocating a String. A contributor might suggest 'just use String' — that would lose the semantic type identity that distinguishes keyword strings from arbitrary strings. The Borrow impl is the idiomatic Rust solution to the owned-key-queried-by-borrowed-key problem.
